segments.name: Performance TV Software
segments.description: Provides a self-serve performance TV software platform that lets marketers target, measure and attribute CTV advertising campaigns.
segments.evidence: Our revolutionary PTV software platform allows marketers to combine the powerful storytelling format of TV advertising with the targeting, measurement and attribution capabilities of paid search and social advertising.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay usage-based fees tied to their ad spend on the platform, recognized net of amounts paid to suppliers for advertising inventory, plus fees for ad production activities.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue is primarily generated through usage-based fees from customers based on their level of ad spend on our platform, net of amounts paid to suppliers for the cost of advertising inventory.

changes.text: In 2025, the company divested Maximum Effort Marketing's creative services business.
changes.evidence: Additionally, we generate revenue through the QuickFrame creative marketplace provided to our customers, and generated revenue through Maximum Effort Marketing's creative services prior to its divestiture on April 1, 2025.
